title: Satin
recognition: Soft luminous highlights, without a mirror-like reflection.

confused_with.difference: Semi-glossy still shows visible (softer) highlights; satin only a broad gentle sheen.
Satin, semi-matte and satin-matte overlap considerably; one photo may not separate them.
